[[Totality Tower|Solar Eclipse Event Night IV]] |first_wave_appearance = 7 ([[Totality Tower]]) |spawned_by = *[[Penumbras]] *[[Lunar Servant]] *[[Solar Shard (Legacy)|Solar Shard]] |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]200 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Slightly Fast (4.5) |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Crumbled}}''' - Upon death the '''Lunar Shard''' spawns a [[Dust]]. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Lunar Shard''' was an [[enemy]] that appeared in the third and fourth night of the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. It did not appear naturally in the [[Tower Outskirts]] and was instead spawned by [[Penumbras]], while in the [[Totality Tower]] it appeared naturally and could be spawned by the [[Lunar Servant]] and [[Solar Shard (Legacy)|Solar Shard]]. It had a low amount of health and had slightly fast speed. Upon death the '''Lunar Shard''' would spawn a [[Dust]]. ==Appearance== The '''Lunar Shard''' had dark purple skin. It had a cracked torso, revealing light blue substance within it. It had glowing pink shoulder-pads and a floating neon moon symbol behind its head. ==Strategy== *Towers with high DPS, such as the [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]], [[Minigunner]] or [[Ranger]] are recommended to defeat this enemy. **You can also use the [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] to boost these towers' firerate and range respectively. *If a '''Lunar Shard''' has low health and is near the end of the map, try not to kill it, as it will transform into a [[Dust]] and do considerably more damage to the base. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} SEthumbnail.png|'''Lunar Shard''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Night Four - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Lunar Shard''' on a promotional video. }} ==Trivia== *When a '''Lunar Shard''' was spawned by the death of a [[Solar Shard (Legacy)|Solar Shard]] in [[Totality Tower]], it was called ''Eclipse's Lunar Shard'' rather than ''Solar Shard's Lunar Shard.'' ==Update History== *'''8 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]]d **'''Lunar Shard''' added. *'''13 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]]g **Now appears in the [[Totality Tower]]. **Health increased from 120 to 200. *'''26 January 2022''' - [[v1.0.1]] **'''Lunar Shard''' removed. {{TotalityTower|[[Wraith]]|Wave 6|Lunar Shard & [[Cobalt Guard (Solar Eclipse)|Cobalt Guard]]|Wave 7|[[Vampire (Solar Eclipse)|Vampire]]|Wave 8}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Tower Outskirts]] {{DISPLAYTITLE:Lunar Shard}}
